comment: She would be good for someone who can take notes from what she's saying, but she hardly puts anything useful on the board, or even finishes the notes she starts writing on the board. Seems scattered and unclear. Her answer is always "Well...yes and no."
Nice person, but very scattered at times when writing notes on the board...alright for people like me who take sporadic notes but may be frustrating for others. Tests very straightforward and doable.
